description: §19.4.5 / §63.5 — a `!{}` handler written with the soft-deprecated `|`-led arms, including the paren-free binder `| .NotFound reason :>`. The deprecated form is in-contract during the window: it surfaces W-ARM-PIPE-LEGACY (Info) once per `|`-led arm (2 here) and runs identically to the canonical `.NotFound(reason) :>` — clicking #go leaves @result = "recovered: was-zero" (the twin of error/handler-recovery-into-cell). The legacy spelling is the PURPOSE of this case; it is not migrated.
rationale: §19.4.5 — a `|`-led `!{}` arm SHALL be the same arm as the arm without the `|` (same AST, emitted code and run-time behaviour), a paren-free binder after a `|`-led variant SHALL be the same pattern as `.V(m)`, and each `|`-led arm SHALL surface W-ARM-PIPE-LEGACY (Info; one per arm). §63.5 — during the window the W-code is a conformance-required code and the deprecated form's runtime is identical to the canonical form's.
